description: Search active job listings in Norway on Kollegia (kollegia.no), including jobs from NAV (arbeidsplassen.nav.no). Returns up to 20 jobs, newest and best title matches first, each with title, employer, location, employment type, deadline, salary (stated in the ad, or an approximate SSB-based estimate marked 'ca.'), a short summary, requirements and the url on kollegia.no where the user reads the full ad and applies. Content is in Norwegian. Combine filters freely; all are optional but give at least one.

employment_type.description: One of: heltid (full-time), deltid (part-time), fast (permanent), vikariat (temporary), sesong (seasonal/summer job), engasjement (fixed-term), lærling (apprentice).

location.description: Norwegian municipality, city district or county, e.g. 'Bergen', 'Tromsø', 'Grünerløkka', 'Vestland', 'Oslo'. Regions like 'Nord-Norge' or 'Vestlandet' also work, and 'hjemmefra' gives remote jobs.

occupation.description: Occupation name in Norwegian, e.g. 'Kokk', 'Elektriker', 'Barnehagelærer'. Matched against job titles.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging.

q.description: Free text matched against job title, employer and occupation, e.g. 'kokk', 'sykepleier natt', 'Rema 1000'. Norwegian words work best.

name: search_jobs

deadline.description: Last day the ad is open (YYYY-MM-DD).

monthly_nok.description: Monthly salary in NOK (median of SSB, or the stated amount converted).

text.description: Salary as shown on kollegia.no, e.g. '250–280 kr/t' or 'ca. 245 kr/t'.

url.description: The job on kollegia.no. Give this to the user; they apply there.

total.description: Number of active jobs matching the filters.

title: Søk i ledige stillinger
